# Front-end transcript: every line runs one step against one catalog and
# one dataset, and tests/planner_spec.rs renders the outcome (the result,
# or the error kind and message) into front_end.golden. Both builds (Rust
# and the vesper-port build) must render it byte for byte.
#
#   ddl: SQL                      HermeticCatalog::apply_ddl
#   rows: TABLE ROW; ROW; ..      DataSet::set_rows (values: 5 i64, 5u u64,
#                                 1.5 f64, true, null, 'text', x'0aff')
#   limits: field=N, ..           limits for the next step only
#   params: name:TYPE=VALUE, ..   parameters for the next query (a name
#                                 ending in ? is declared only, one starting
#                                 with + is bound only)
#   query: SQL                    prepare, optimized, execute
ddl: CREATE TABLE t (id I64 NOT NULL, u U64, f F64, b BOOL, s TEXT, x BYTES)

query: SELECT * FROM t
query: SELECT id, s FROM t WHERE u > 5u AND f < 2.0e0
query: SELECT id FROM t WHERE f >= 1.5
query: SELECT id, s AS name FROM t WHERE s >= 'one' OR s IS NULL
query: SELECT t.id, t2.label FROM t JOIN t2 ON t2.id = t.id
query: SELECT a.id, b.id AS bid FROM t a LEFT JOIN t2 b ON b.id = a.id WHERE b.label IS NULL
query: SELECT a.id, b.id AS bid FROM t a RIGHT OUTER JOIN t2 b ON b.id = a.id WHERE a.u <> 9u
query: SELECT a.id, b.id AS bid FROM t a FULL JOIN t2 b ON b.id = a.id AND b.w > -3
query: SELECT a.id, b.id AS bid FROM t a INNER JOIN t b ON a.id < b.id WHERE NOT (a.b = b.b) AND a.x <= b.x
query: SELECT id, b IS NOT NULL AS known, NOT b AS nb, (b OR NULL) AS o FROM t WHERE TRUE;
query: SELECT id FROM t WHERE (((id = 1)))
query: SELECT id FROM t WHERE x = x'01'
